I have a compiling Lean 4 project that builds against MathLib (lake build ExplicitFormula passes). New to how to structure these kinds of projects. Might be nothing, but have to start somewhere. Generated summary extracted from the README of my repo.

Looking to talk to someone directly about how to evaluate this... I claim nothing. ;)

The standard Weil quadratic form evaluates |ĥ(ρ)|² at each zeta zero. This squaring discards phase information: it is a lossy projection that makes the form monotone under added spectral mass. A symmetry-preserving off-line quartet (four zeros replacing an on-line pair) adds mass and makes the Weil form MORE positive, rendering it blind to displacement.

The linear spectral bilinear form preserves phase. On a centered Hermite-Gaussian basis, the pair-replacement operator is block-diagonal by parity:

  • Even block: may remain PSD
  • Odd block: exactly -2bb^T (rank-1 negative semidefinite) when beta != 0
  • Cross block: exactly zero

The odd block carries the displacement signal that squaring destroys.
